name: Maximum Sum Subarray With At Least K Elements
statement:
1. You are given an array(arr) of integers and a number k.
2. You have to find maximum subarray sum in the given array.
3. The subarray must have at least k elements.
inputFormat:
A number N
a1
a2.. N integers
A number K
outputFormat: A number representing maximum subarray sum with subarray having at least K elements.
